name: Pipeline access control
summary: Who and what may drive the processing pipeline: the platform routes Antman uses to change jobs and realities, job status updates from the web, and Antman's own internal views. Today several of these are wider than their purpose needs.

roles.note: These grants describe today's code, not intent. Service callers (Antman, capture-api) use shared secrets or a forwarded sign-in token. Intended access is DEC-059.

actions.action: Change any job's or reality's status through the Antman platform routes
actions.note: Access details for this item are handled with engineering separately.
